tasks.catch_marbles_trapdoors: Press the matching-color button to trap the target marble into the box.
tasks.catch_ramp_ball: Place the blue cup in front of the ramp to catch the red ball before hitting the table.
tasks.catch_cuboid: Grasp and pull out cuboid(s) once it(they) emerge from the box.
tasks.catch_shelf_marble: Move the bowl to left and right by pressing the corresponding keys to catch the red ball.
tasks.catch_valley_ball: Push the blue box in front of the ramp behind the red line to catch the red ball.
tasks.stop_valley_ball: Hold the ping-pong bat so the red ball hits its circular head before the table.
tasks.cook_meat: Cook the steak on the pan to the target doneness and return it to the board.
tasks.cook_meat_timer: Cook the steak using the pie timer (green→yellow→red) and return it to the board.
tasks.put_cup_belt: Place the cup in the slot between the yellow tools on the belt.
tasks.dispense_gummy: Dispense gummies and move the bowl so only the target-colored gummies are collected.
tasks.punch_dual_holes: Punch every present tile on both belts.
tasks.save_goal: Place the goalkeeper to block the ball from entering the goal.
tasks.hit_target: Hit the moving target's yellow center while avoiding blockers.
tasks.load_train: Drop the marble into an allowed wagon of the circling train.
tasks.marble_shelf_maze: Tilt the shelves to route the marble through the maze into the bowl.
tasks.pack_fruits: Pack red and green apples from the belts into their matching baskets.
tasks.pick_ripe_apple: Pick the good apple and place it in the basket while ignoring spoiled fruit.
tasks.place_block_belt: Place the block onto the belt so it rides upright into the exit bowl.
tasks.play_billiard: Strike the red ball into an allowed pocket without robot contact.
tasks.control_quality: Stamp red and green tiles while skipping black outliers.
tasks.drop_ball_hole: Guide the ball through the target hole of the rotating sorter into the container.
tasks.sort_apples_belt: Sort red and green apples into matching bins; send rotten apples to the dump.
tasks.whack_moles: Whack both moles from above without touching a rabbit.
tasks.trap_bug: Trap the scurrying bug under the glass box.
tasks.boil_milk: Turn the stove on so the milk rises, then shut it off before the milk overflows.
tasks.fill_coffee_jar: Fill the marked glass jar to the target line.
tasks.pour_beer: Pour beer into the mug, then click the finish bell. Overflow fails.
tasks.cook_food: Shut the stove off at the target doneness (food starts in the pan).
tasks.cook_food_timer: Shut the stove off at the target doneness using the pie timer (food starts in the pan).
tasks.measure_ingredient: Fill the marked jar to the target ring from the oil nozzle.
tasks.make_soup: Tip the chopping-board vegetables into the pot without dropping any pieces.
tasks.catch_cup: Place the pillow under the tipping mug so it lands softly instead of hitting the table.
tasks.catch_mouse_object_drop: Place the pillow-lined basket under the falling object so it does not hit the table.
tasks.stop_ball: Place the gripper-shaped bridge so it stops the rolling ball before the ball falls off the table.
tasks.clean_table: Wipe the spreading coffee spill with the sponge before it reaches the laptop.
